text: Fine-grained reactivity: when state changes, only the code that depends on it reruns
quote: Declare your state and use it throughout your app, and when a piece of state changes, only the code that depends on it will rerun.

text: Automatic dependency tracking: reading reactive state subscribes to it
quote: Automatic dependency tracking: accessing your reactive state subscribes to it

text: Create reactive state as signals with an accessor and a setter
quote: Create a piece of reactive state, giving us an accessor, count(), and a setter, setCount()

text: Create derived state by wrapping an expression in a function
quote: To create derived state, just wrap an expression in a function

text: Built-in global state management with Context and Stores, so no third-party library is needed
quote: Performant state management is built-in with Context and Stores: you don't have to reach for a third party library to manage global state

text: Resources let server-loaded data act like regular state, with Suspense and concurrent rendering for a responsive loading UI
quote: With Resources, you can use data loaded from the server like any other piece of state and build a responsive UI for it thanks to Suspense and concurrent rendering.

text: Full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration to make pages interactive quickly
quote: Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.

text: Server rendering runs on Node LTS and the latest Deno and Cloudflare Worker runtimes, with serverless support
quote: For server environments, we support Node LTS and the latest Deno and Cloudflare Worker runtimes.

text: Isomorphic: components can render on both the client and the server
quote: Isomorphic: render your components on the client and the server

text: Renders real DOM elements, so the output can be inspected and debugged in browser devtools
quote: Naturally debuggable: A `<div>` is a real div, so you can use your browser's devtools to inspect the rendering

text: Custom renderers let Solid target environments other than the browser DOM
quote: Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere

text: Works well with web components and can author custom elements
quote: Web component friendly and can author custom elements

text: Direct DOM access makes it easy to integrate native JS libraries such as D3
quote: Solid's bare-metal, minimal abstractions give you direct access to the DOM, making it easy to use your favorite native JavaScript libraries like D3.

text: Render-once model: components are plain functions that run once to set up the view
quote: Render-once mental model: your components are regular JavaScript functions that run once to set up your view

text: Provides JSX, fragments, Portals, Error Boundaries and concurrent rendering
quote: Provides modern framework features like JSX, fragments, Context, Portals, Suspense, streaming SSR, progressive hydration, Error Boundaries and concurrent rendering.

text: Components are just functions, so code can be organized freely without learning a new rendering system
quote: In Solid, components are just functions - rendering is determined purely by how your state is used - so you're free to organize your code how you like and you don't have to learn a new rendering system.

text: Built on JSX and TypeScript and integrates with the Vite ecosystem
quote: Solid is built on established tools like JSX and TypeScript and integrates with the Vite ecosystem.

text: Compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions instead of using a Virtual DOM
quote: Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles its templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions.

text: Official JS and TypeScript templates scaffold a minimal Vite-powered app with one degit command
quote: Or for TypeScript: npx degit solidjs/templates/ts my-app

text: Can be set up in existing builds by adding babel-preset-solid to Babel, webpack or Rollup config
quote: The easiest way to get set up is to add `babel-preset-solid` to your `.babelrc`, babel config for webpack, or rollup configuration

text: TypeScript JSX is configured through jsxImportSource set to solid-js
quote:
"jsx": "preserve",
  "jsxImportSource": "solid-js",

text: An online playground lets you try Solid code in the browser
quote: Try this code in our playground!

text: Small, fully tree-shakable library that also renders fast on the server
quote: Solid is small and completely tree-shakable, and fast when rendering on the server, too.

text: Growing ecosystem of custom primitives, component libraries and build-time utilities
quote: the Solid ecosystem is growing fast, with custom primitives, component libraries, and build-time utilities
